customer_message.body:
Hello

As I understand it: Only I received the termination form, not my wife; We have both lived here for nine years and cannot find another home quickly; I cannot safely say more.

Regarding “family-home termination with a possible service defect”, for today's submission: the delivery to spouse remains unresolved; for the request “check form, service, challenge deadline and extension”: I have included everything currently available to me; on “family-home termination with a possible service defect”, I want a traceable assessment; also unresolved: the landlord reason; I would like this position reviewed.

This leaves me requesting: check form, service, challenge deadline and extension; in particular, I need clarity about the landlord reason and whether the records support an initial assessment.

My first note about it is dated 30 May 2025.

Thank you for clarifying; What matters most is the delivery to spouse; I can then decide how to proceed.

Yours sincerely
customer_message.subject: Request for review: family-home termination with a possible service defect
